tha-ap186:2.2: cāturā → caturo (bj) | cāturā ṭhapitā → catuoṭṭhapitā (sya-all); catur oṭṭhapitā (pts) | oṭṭhapitā → G. catu oṭṭhāpitā; S1 catu oṭṭhapikā; S2 oṭapitā. (pts note)
tha-ap186:2.4: paggaṇhiṁ vatasiddhiyā → puttomhi hitasiddhiyā (sya-all) | vatasiddhiyā → hitasiddhiyā (bj: syā) | vatasiddhiyā → puttomhi hitasiddhiyā (cck: syā.) | mhi → G. pugomhi. (pts note)
tha-ap186:3.3: buddharaṁsīhi phuṭṭhosmi pūjesiṁ dvipaduttamaṁ → buddharaṁsyābhiphuṭṭhombhi pūjeyiṁ dipaduttamaṁ (bj) | phuṭṭhosmi → phuṭṭhomhi (sya-all) | buddharaṁsīhi phuṭṭhosmi → buddharaṁsābhighuṭṭho mhi (pts) | buddharaṁsyābhiphuṭṭhombhi → budadharaṁsīhi phuṭṭhosmi (bj: machasaṁ); khuddharaṁsibhi phuṭṭhomhi (bj: PTS) | phuṭṭhosmi → buddharaṁsyābhiphuṭṭhomhi (cck: sī.); buddharaṁsābhighuṭṭhosmi (cck: ka.)
tha-ap186:3.4: dvipaduttamaṁ → dipaduttamaṁ (sya-all, pts) | pūjesiṁ → G. pūjesi. (pts note) | dipaduttamaṁ → G. dvīpad-. (pts note)
tha-ap186:4.2: pupphamabhipūjayiṁ → pupphamabhiropayiṁ (bj, sya-all, pts) | abhiropayiṁ → G. abhipūjayiṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap186:5.2: susabhasammatā → sulabhasammatā (sya-all) | pañca susabhasammatā → pañc āsu sabhāsammatā (pts) | Sabhāsammatā → S1 pañcasu sahasammatā; G. pañcasūsabhasampadā. (pts note)
